title: GraphBLAST: A High-Performance Linear Algebra-based Graph Framework on the GPU
venue: arXiv; later published in ACM TOPC
gpu_scope: Inspected CUDA implementation; host orchestration and input conversion remain outside GPU kernels. No build or runtime validation performed.
notes: Single-seed approximate PageRank vector from GPU residual pushing. The source uses a lazy walk: to match ordinary-walk restart probability r, use upstream alpha=r/(2-r). Restrict to undirected graphs with positive degree, report approximation and iteration termination, and check residual/missing mass before claiming the requested tolerance. The routine alone does not return a local community.
